info.name: GET - All Users
info.description: Importable single-request collection validating pagination and user contract.

exec: pm.test("Users collection contract", () => { pm.expect(j.users).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.total).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(j.limit).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(j.skip).to.be.a("number"); });

pm.test("Every returned user has core fields", () => j.users.forEach(u => { pm.expect(u).to.have.all.keys("id","firstName","lastName","maidenName","age","gender","email","phone","username","password","birthDate","image","bloodGroup","height","weight","eyeColor","hair","ip","address","macAddress","university","bank","company","ein","ssn","userAgent","crypto","role"); }));
